quests.title: Wanmin Fresh

dialogue.sit: I've got something else to do.

dialogue.t: Ah, alright. I'll think of another way...
Do be careful. Don't touch any strange elements, and try not to get injured, either.

dialogue.section: Deliver the food to Tacit Tingfang

dialogue.sit: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogue.t: You heard correctly. Someone named Tingfang ordered a serving of Jewelry Soup earlier before heading off to Qingxu Pool.
I don't know what matter he needs to attend to, but I can say with confidence that you can't find any fault with our Jewelry Soup.
Could I trouble you to deliver this Jewelry Soup for me? Just try not to use your wind glider to get there, or some of the soup might spill.
Thank you. Chef Mao is better than Smiley Yanxiao.

quests.description: Wanmin Restaurant has taken a custom order that now awaits delivery...
